audience: A reader who wants a small dependable calculation; programming is one optional deliverable, not the assumed reader profession
purpose: A local command comparing an amount with a baseline, demonstrated with fictional100mmversus80mm
runtime: Python3.9or later; standard library only; no network, credentials or modelAPI
input_contract: Exactly two command-line arguments: amount and baseline, in the same units
Plain ASCII decimal notation only: digits with optional decimal point and optional leading plus; no exponent, NaN, infinity or minus sign
Each argument1–32characters; no surrounding whitespace; amount0through100000inclusive; baselinegreaterthan0through100000inclusive
output_contract: On valid input print one JSON object tostdout and exit0; no stderr
Keys amount,baseline,difference,percent_above,percent_of,notice; numeric fields are decimal strings with exactly2fractional digits, rounded ROUND_HALF_UP
notice must say: Comparison only; no trend, cause or forecast is established.
On invalid input/argumentcount, exit2, print one helpful line starting STOP: tostderr, stdout empty, no traceback
Reject invalid input before calculating or emitting a result; no loop, network/file writes or extra dependencies
acceptance: Keep rawseed, independentfindings, correction, outputchecks and rejected-input/recovery evidence; work-history metadata is separate from user-facing calculator output
schema: Return JSON files mapping compare_amounts.py to complete source string, plus dispositions list. Host supplies independent fixed-expectation tests.
